prompt: A primordial field of Dynamic Matter on the early Earth before the first living organism. An intricate landscape of self-organizing chemistry, chemical gardens, hydrothermal mineral formations, translucent mineral membranes, lipid vesicles, branching tubular structures, liquid crystal textures, swirling molecular networks, suspended droplets, glowing reaction gradients, flowing energy currents, minerals continually assembling, dissolving, and recombining. No recognizable cell, no complete organism, no planet, no landscape horizon--only an immersive microscopic world at the threshold where nonliving matter is becoming living matter. Beautiful, luminous, ethereal, painterly realism, translucent whites, blues, soft ambers and gold, highly detailed organic textures, dramatic black background, elegant scientific imagination, museum-quality scientific art. --ar 3:4 --v 8.2
